beats.event: Arrested on his 30th birthday for an unspecified crime
Told he remains free to work; landlady tries to console him
Harasses Fräulein Bürstner with an unwanted kiss
Summoned to court without time or location given
Court sits in a slum attic; mistaken for a painter
His plea against the trial's absurdity draws hostility
Returns; court not in session; usher's wife seduces him
Finds the arresting agents whipped in his own bank
Uncle brings him to Herr Huld, a bedridden lawyer
Begins secret trysts with Huld's servant Leni
Painter Titorelli: only postponement or partial acquittal exist
Dismisses Huld; meets the ruined merchant Block
Priest tells him the parable Before the Law
Two men come at midnight and stab him in a quarry
